verdict.rationale: Letta explicitly documents a headless mode for Letta Code designed to run non-interactively in scripts and CI/CD pipelines, including an ephemeral one-shot flag for stateless automation runs, plus SDK-based programmatic agent creation/session resumption that supports headless orchestration. missing for 10: independent/community-verified CI usage examples and no evidence of official CI templates (e.g., GitHub Actions integration).
